columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. System generated value.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Stores the ID of entity object for which the followup task is created. Eg. PERSON_ID etc.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the entity against which the followup task is created. Eg. ORA_CANDIDATE etc.

columns.name: CONTEXT_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the context against which the followup task is created. Eg. Submission, Pool, Prospect, General Profile etc.

columns.name: CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Stores the ID of the context object for which the followup task is created. Eg. SUBMISSION_ID, POOL_ID, PERSON_ID etc.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Stores the date by which the followup task has to be done.

columns.name: COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Stores the timestamp when the followup task was marked as completed.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the status of the followup task. Lookup type is ORA_IRC_FOLLOWUP_TASK_STATUS

columns.name: NOTE_TEXT
columns.description: Stores the text for the followup task.

columns.name: COMPLETED_BY_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to per_persons table. Stores the PERSON_ID of the person who completed the followup task.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
